invariants.observation_vs_interpretation: Observations and claims are stored separately.
invariants.claims_vs_evidence: Caller assertions never become independently verified evidence.
invariants.source_provenance: Every observation has an explicit source and authority classification.
invariants.chronology: Recording order is reconstructable with monotonic events and UTC times.
invariants.stable_identity: Canonical content and request identity produce deterministic IDs.
invariants.immutable_history: Corrections append relationships; historical rows cannot be updated or deleted.
invariants.partial_capture: Reserved and failed attempts remain visible and retryable.
invariants.derived_authority: Derived consumers cannot upgrade source authority.
invariants.source_vs_runtime: Database and runtime artifacts are excluded from Git.
invariants.no_governance: BlackBox records evidence and never approves or blocks observed actions.
